IC1: Age from 40 to 80 years old, either gender;
IC2: Patients with bilateral age related cataracts, require bilateral cataract phacoemulsification combined Intraocular Lens implantation;
IC3: Willing to undergo second eye surgery within 7 days after first eye surgery;
IC4: The potential postoperative visual acuity of 20/40 or better in both eyes;
IC5: Preoperative measurement of corneal astigmatism indicate the subjects are suitable for [AND] multifocal intraocular lenses implantation;
IC6: Capability to understand the informed consent and willing and able to attend study
